programs.title: Let Love Grow
programs.desc: (2022) Romance starring Jennifer Bonner. Landscape architect Evie is a hit with stubborn new client Ryan's daughters - leading her to realise she's the subject of Operation Grow a Girlfriend!

programs.title: The Way To The Heart
programs.desc: (2022) Romance with Meghan Heffern. When a big-city chef loses her spark, her boss insists she takes a break to find herself again. Will a visit to her hometown help her rediscover her passions?

programs.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programs.desc: (2023) Flavourful romance starring Laura Miyata and David Lafontaine. An NYC baker would love to land a cookbook deal. Will a dash of royalty and a spoonful of romance help fulfil her dream?

programs.title: Love, Romance and Chocolate
programs.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts?

programs.title: With Love, Your Sweetly Salted
programs.desc: (2023) Anonymous food critic Alison goes undercover as a prep cook to make amends with the chef she accidentally trashed online, but things soon begin to heat up in the kitchen.

programs.title: The Royal Bake Off
programs.desc: (2023) Showstopper romance with Ansley Gordon and Christian Howard. There's no room for soggy bottoms as two rivals compete to bake a cake fit for a King. But who will be crowned royal star baker?
